decision.rationale: The provider-neutral v2 boundary is implemented and fails closed, but the prospective decision dataset, exact semantic verifier, calibrated thresholds, and current-image publication evidence do not exist yet.
limitations: This is build evidence, not method-quality evidence.
The 80 referenced v1 cases are consumed and development-only.
No candidate model, provider, threshold, cost, latency, or memory result is selected.
V8 image health does not apply to the changed V9 source revision.
